purpose: Freeze occurrence-to-semantic-node identity independently of model, candidate, verifier, and prior residual artifacts.

rowContract.identityGroupIdRule: All physical heading occurrences in one semantic node share one reviewer-assigned group ID; group IDs are document-local and deterministic after row order is frozen.
rowContract.continuationDirectionRule: A CONTINUATION row points only to an earlier HEADING occurrence in the same identityGroupId.
rowContract.unresolvedRule: UNRESOLVED rows have no identityGroupId and are excluded from strict identity scoring until adjudicated.

derivedPairRelations.source: frozen heading rows and identityGroupId membership
rules: Different resolved identityGroupId values derive DISTINCT.
A continuationOfOccurrenceId derives directed CONTINUATION_OF from later occurrence to referenced earlier occurrence.
Resolved occurrences in the same group without a continuation edge derive SAME_SEMANTIC_REPEAT.
Any pair containing an UNRESOLVED occurrence is UNKNOWN and excluded from strict pair scoring.

validationInvariants: sourceSha256 matches the frozen holdout manifest
sourcePacketSha256 matches the sealed source-only packet
every sourceId/stableId/span is present in the packet
source spans are legal and non-duplicated
rows are deterministically ordered by sourceOrdinal then sourceId
HEADING rows have exactly one identityGroupId
CONTINUATION points backward within its group
identity groups do not cross document scope
derived relation graph has no contradictory continuation parent
semantic node IDs and pair relations are derived only after freeze
strictEligibility: reviewedEntireDocument=true and headingSetExhaustive=true and unresolvedSemanticUncertainty=false and all source/hash/identity invariants pass
